users.disableConfirm: Disable account for {{email}}? They will not be able to log in.
users.deleteWarning: This will permanently delete {{name}} and ALL of their content ({{flightCount}} flights, {{aircraftCount}} aircraft, plus licenses, contacts, credentials, backups, and notifications). This action cannot be undone.
users.auditTrailNote: This action will be logged to the admin audit trail.

maintenance.tokenCleanupDesc: Delete expired and revoked refresh tokens and used password reset tokens from the database.
maintenance.smtpTestDesc: Send a test email to your admin email address to verify SMTP configuration is working.
maintenance.unverifiedSweepDesc: Send any due verification reminders, then delete accounts that were reminded longer ago than the retention window and are still unverified.
maintenance.unverifiedSweepWarning: Deletion is irreversible and removes everything the account owns.
maintenance.unverifiedResult: Sweep complete: {{reminders}} reminder(s) sent, {{deleted}} account(s) deleted.

disabledReason.oidc_mode: Single sign-on is in charge of accounts here. An unverified account means the provider did not confirm the address — not that the account was abandoned — so deleting on that basis would remove accounts that are in use. This cannot be switched on in SSO mode.
disabledReason.smtp_not_configured: SMTP is not configured, so accounts are marked verified at sign-up and there is nothing to chase.

maintenance.notificationCheckDesc: Immediately run the expiry-notification checker for all users, bypassing the daily check-hour gating. Useful after changing notification settings or for testing email delivery.

config.title: Runtime Configuration
config.subtitle: Non-secret server configuration. Secrets are never exposed.

announcements.createDesc: Announcements appear as banners for all users. Auto-hints (2FA, first flight) are system-generated.
announcements.messagePlaceholder: e.g. Scheduled maintenance on Tuesday at 8pm UTC

email.suppressedTitle: This address refused mail permanently. Nothing further is sent to it, so the account cannot be verified until the suppression is lifted.
email.suppressionsDesc: Addresses that refused mail permanently. Nothing is sent to them. Lift a suppression once the mailbox is known to work again.
email.noSuppressions: No suppressed addresses — every recipient is still accepting mail.
email.liftSuccess: Mail to {{email}} will be attempted again.
email.liftFailed: Could not lift the suppression for {{email}}.
email.deliveriesDesc: What the receiving server said about each message we sent.
email.asyncCaveat: Delivered means the receiving server accepted the message, not that it reached an inbox — a server that accepts and then bounces later is not visible here.
